intro: Serbia is a parliamentary republic and a candidate to join the European Union, while also keeping close ties with Russia and China.

chapters.title: President and assembly
text: The president is directly elected for five years; the 250-member National Assembly chooses the government. Aleksandar Vučić has been president since 2017.
Serbia is militarily neutral and not a member of NATO.

chapters.title: Kosovo
text: Serbia considers Kosovo part of its territory. More than a hundred countries recognise Kosovo's independence; others, including Russia and China, do not.

keyTerms.meaning: Not part of any military alliance.
